home.about: An end-unit townhome in Dallas' Copperfield community, beside a large greenbelt. The living and dining areas open to an eat-in kitchen, and the first-floor primary suite opens to a private patio. Recent updates include HVAC, roof and fresh paint.

numbers.disclaimer: Estimates only, prepared 10/24/2026; not a loan approval or commitment to lend. $425,000 price, 30-year fixed conventional at 7.490% with no discount points (APR 7.810% with 5% down; 7.599% with 20% down). Payment = principal, interest, est. taxes ($673/mo), insurance ($300/mo) and mortgage insurance with 5% down ($91/mo); HOA ($434/mo) not included. Cash to close includes a $2,386 seller title credit, which must be agreed in the contract and is subject to loan program limits. Actual rate, payment and costs could be higher; get an official Loan Estimate before choosing a loan. neighborhood.community: Copperfield is a Lake Highlands townhome community set beside a greenbelt and creek, with a community pool, a clubhouse and walking paths. Walne Park and the White Rock Trail are minutes away, and Lakeridge Village adds a brewery, a bistro and Michelin-recognized tacos. Richardson ISD schools serve the home.
